name: AWS Lake Formation
sku: AWS Lake Formation permissions layer over the AWS Glue Data Catalog.

bands.note: Its own permissions model on top of IAM, enforced at database, table, column, row and cell level across Athena, Redshift Spectrum, EMR and Glue ETL. It governs data cataloged in Glue, not data outside the catalog.
LF-Tags are labels attached to databases, tables or columns, so a few tag-based policies replace per-resource permissions across thousands of resources.
Adds text-based search over cataloged metadata and labels, and federates external sources such as Redshift and S3 Tables into the Glue Data Catalog. The catalog itself is AWS Glue's.

presentation.tagline: Central permissions and tag-based governance for data lakes on S3.

cost.note: Database, table, column, row and cell-level permissions and cross-account sharing are free. Governed Tables (transactional tables, charged per API request) and the Storage Optimizer are separate, optional paid features not scored on this record, so not included here.
Same as prototype: the permissions layer itself stays free regardless of volume.
Same as prototype: the permissions layer itself stays free regardless of volume. The underlying S3, Glue and Athena usage it governs is priced on those services' own records.
